answer: Because the timing is entered against the vine challenge, the vertex audit can replay the fable history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 299 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 186 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
